$comment: Time-boxed acceptances for dependency advisories (ADR-0056). Every entry states its evidence (`reason`), names the task that decided it (`task`), and expires (`reviewBy`) so an accepted risk cannot silently become permanent — `pnpm audit:deps` reds the day after. `tool: "cargo"` entries document Rust-side dismissals; the npm gate ignores them. Prune an entry once the advisory stops being reported (the gate lists prunable entries).

entries.reason: Tauri 2's gtk-0.18 Linux stack pins glib 0.18.5 (via gdk 0.18.2); the fix is in glib 0.20. Re-checked 2026-10-09 on crates.io: gtk 0.19 (glib ^0.22) exists upstream, but the newest tauri 2.12.2 / tao 0.37.1 / wry 0.57.0 (and tauri 3.0.0-alpha.4) still require gtk ^0.18, so Snug cannot take it yet. Snug ships a macOS DMG only — Linux is compiled in the CI workspace leg but never released. The finding is local Iterator unsoundness, not a remotely reachable path.
